gloss: New Year period (while pine decorations are up)

definitions.gloss: the New Year period (while the pine decorations are up)
definitions.explanation: The first days of the year during which {門松|かどまつ} and other New Year decorations stay up: until January 7 in most of Japan, until January 15 in parts of the Kansai region.

examples.japanese: {松|まつ}の{内|うち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧。
{松|まつ}の{内|うち}のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I sent replies to my New Year's cards while it was still the New Year period.

examples.japanese: {松|まつ}の{内|うち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、「{寒中見舞|かんちゅうみま}い」⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: After the New Year period is over, it is usual to send a midwinter greeting instead of a New Year greeting.

notes:
⟦{松|まつ}→松：02256_matsu⟧ (pine, from the ⟦{門松|かどまつ}→門松：14522_kadomatsu⟧ pine decorations) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内|うち}→内：01328_uchi⟧ (within).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {松|まつ}の{内|うち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧: the New Year period ends
- {松|まつ}の{内|うち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: during the New Year period
- {松|まつ}の{内|うち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧: to be past the New Year period

CULTURAL NOTE:
New Year greetings and cards (⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧) belong to the {松|まつ}の{内|うち}; after it, people say {寒中|かんちゅう}⟦お{見舞|みま}い→お見舞い：01351_omimai⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧ instead. The decorations are taken down when it ends.
